newsitem.title: USA: California Microwave chairman to leave.
newsitem.headline: California Microwave chairman to leave.

text.p: California Microwave Inc said on Wednesday Chairman David Leeson would leave the company to return to his commitments as a professor at Stanford University.
Board member Al Gray, former commandant of the U.S. Marine Corps, would assume the post, the company said.
Leeson had been appointed to lead the company and stabilise operations following last year's resignation of former chairman Philip Otto, the company said.
California Microwave supplies satellite earth stations and microwave radio infrastructure products.
